probes.why: A pull_request_target or workflow_run workflow checks out the pull request's code with secrets in reach.
probes.fix: Use pull_request for untrusted code, or check it out only after a maintainer's label or approval gate.

probes.why: Text an outsider writes (a title, a body, a branch name) is pasted into a run: script.
probes.fix: Pass it through env: (FOO: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}) and use "$FOO" in the script.

probes.why: A workflow's token gets write access it may not need.
probes.fix: Add `permissions: contents: read` at the top and grant writes only on the jobs that need them.

probes.why: An action used by tag, or a script piped from the internet, can change under you (as tj-actions/changed-files did).
probes.fix: Pin each action to its full commit (uses: owner/action@<40-character sha> # v4) and download scripts before running them.

probes.why: The default branch can be force-pushed or merged into without review or checks.
probes.fix: Add a ruleset on the default branch: block force pushes and deletion, require a review and the CI checks.

probes.why: No SECURITY.md tells people how to report a vulnerability privately.
probes.fix: Add SECURITY.md with a contact and a disclosure timeline, and turn on private vulnerability reporting.

probes.why: Recent releases carry no signature or provenance file to check them against.
probes.fix: Sign release assets with Sigstore (actions/attest-build-provenance) or publish .intoto.jsonl provenance.

probes.why: No SBOM in the repo or the release assets.
probes.fix: Attach an SPDX or CycloneDX SBOM to each release (anchore/sbom-action).

probes.why: No code scanning (CodeQL, Semgrep, SonarCloud) runs on pull requests.
probes.fix: Turn on CodeQL's default setup in the repo's Security settings, or add a Semgrep workflow.

probes.why: Compiled files are committed, so nobody can review what they do.
probes.fix: Build them in CI instead and remove them from the repo.
Add ClusterFuzzLite, Go native fuzz tests, or join OSS-Fuzz.
Fill in the questionnaire at bestpractices.dev.

probes.why: Releases aren't published by a workflow, so their build can't be traced.
probes.fix: Publish from a workflow (with trusted publishing on PyPI and npm).
